# TIFF test corpus

Every `.tif` here is generated by `tools/gen-tiff-corpus.py` (Pillow driving libtiff) from synthetic pixels, so there is no
third-party image content and the files are covered by the project license (MIT OR Apache-2.0). Each file has a `.raw`
next to it with the expected pixels in the library's layout; `manifest.txt` lists name, size and pixel format.
The expected pixels were checked against libtiff's own decode when the files were written.

`jpeg/` holds JPEG-compressed TIFFs with libjpeg's decoded pixels, for when the JPEG codec is connected to the TIFF decoder.
Regenerate everything with `python3 tools/gen-tiff-corpus.py`.
